mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6% signals a tightening labor market, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to impending wage inflation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 6.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeds 5% YoY and simultaneously, the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 3% YoY, it signals supply chain bottlenecks, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in supply-constrained periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above $550B signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when RSAFS > 550000.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and simultaneously, the CPI (CPIAUCSL) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a monetary policy mismatch, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in mismatch periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained non-farm payroll (PAYEMS) growth above 200k signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are below 1200 units and simultaneously, retail sales (RSAFS) are above $525B, it signals a demand shift, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST < 1200 and RSAFS > 525000.
